Security is the product

VaultGuard enforces phishing-resistant MFA, hardware-key attestation, and just-in-time elevation for every privileged session.

SOC 2 Type II ISO 27001 FedRAMP Moderate (In Process) HIPAA BAA Available

Transport & header hardening

Every VaultGuard endpoint ships with strict transport security. Our public endpoints return HSTS with a one-year max-age, include the preload directive, and are submitted to the Chromium HSTS preload list. Content is served with Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload.

  • TLS 1.3 only — TLS 1.0/1.1 and RC4/3DES cipher suites are rejected at the edge
  • OCSP stapling with must-staple certificates
  • Certificate transparency monitoring for all *.vaultguard.io issuance
  • Expect-CT enforcement during migration (now default-deny)

Responsible disclosure

Report vulnerabilities to security@vaultguard.io. We commit to a 24-hour acknowledgement and publish advisories within 90 days of a fix. Our PGP key fingerprint is published at /.well-known/security.txt.
